facts.fact: 纸上只是调剂量、换成分的试错，落到维克多身上是一具身体和一个脑子的残酷消耗
facts.anchor: But what was on paper a matter of adjusting doses, swapping chemical ingredients, monitoring interactions was in reality a gruesome process.

facts.fact: 每次试验失败后他都被迫退回哈弗蒂的原血清，只为把心跳稳到下一轮
facts.anchor: he was forced to return to the numbing poison of Haverty’s original serum, just to stabilize his heart until the next trial

facts.fact: 有一天丹妮递给他一支新药管，里面的液体不再是蓝色，而是紫色
facts.anchor: And then, one day, she handed him a fresh cartridge, the liquid inside no longer blue, but violet.

facts.fact: 维克多把丹妮的最新配方装进吸入器，丹妮把计时器定在五分钟
facts.anchor: Victor slotted her latest formula into the inhaler as Dani set the timer for five minutes.

facts.fact: 五分钟过去变成十分钟、再变成十五分钟，死亡始终没有伸手来够他
facts.anchor: Five minutes became ten, and then fifteen, and still death showed no sign of reaching out for him.

facts.fact: 维克多用能力捏住闯入者的神经，把旋钮拧到足以烧掉线路，那人当场倒下
facts.anchor: took hold of the intruder’s nerves, and snapped the dial up, hard and fast enough to blow the circuitry

facts.fact: 丹妮估计药效能维持八到十二小时，因为配方是照着原来那支做的
facts.anchor: “My guess is anywhere from eight to twelve hours, since I modeled it on the original.”

facts.fact: 丹妮说紫色药剂只是原型、还要多跑测试，让他先用回旧配方
facts.anchor: is a prototype, not a finished product, and until I can run more tests, I want you to keep using the old compound.
